spec.description: Shows whether the cluster serves RW requests (select, insert, update, delete) through the endpoint.
spec.title: Smoke Test

spec.expr: sum by () (ma_pg_patroni_cluster_status{namespace="$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster"} or ma_pg_metrics_running{namespace="$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", pg_node='External'})
spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM /pg.$cluster_name.cluster.status/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter
SELECT mean(value) FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\..*\.pg_metrics\.replication\.(.*).sent_lag/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the difference between the current XLOG location and the data that was sent to recipient.
spec.title: Sent lag

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\..*\.pg_metrics\.replication\.(.*).sent_replay_lag/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the difference between the sent XLOG location and applied to the recipient XLOG location.
spec.title: Sent/Replay lag

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM /pg.$cluster_name.*.archive.mode/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter

spec.description: If archive mode is on, then the WAL archive is enabled. Otherwise, the WAL archive is disabled.
spec.title: Archive mode

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM /pg.$cluster_name.nodes.node.*.patroni_status/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("value") FROM /pg.$cluster_name.cluster.status/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter
SELECT mean("value") / 1024 / 1024 FROM /pg.common.size_by_database.*/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(previous)

spec.description: This graph shows size for all of the logical databases in PostgreSQL cluster.
spec.title: Size by database

spec.description: This graph shows number of table in each of the logical databases.
spec.title: Number of Tables

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg.common.connection_count_stat.*/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(previous)

spec.description: Shows how many connections are in use right now. It shows max connections, used connections, reserved for regular, and superuser.
spec.title: Overall connection statistic

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg.common.connection_by_database.*/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(previous)

spec.description: Shows the number of connections per database.
spec.title: Connection by database

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg.common.connection_by_database.*/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(previous)

spec.description: Shows the number of connections per role.
spec.title: Connection by role

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg.common.count_not_idle.*/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(previous)

spec.description: Shows the number of not idle connections per database.
spec.title: Not idle connections by Database

spec.query: SELECT top("$column", $limit) as "$column", "short_query", "datname", "mean_time", "queryid" FROM (SELECT LAST("queryid_val"), * FROM "ma.pg.common.queries_stat" WHERE $timeFilter and ("datname" = '$datname' OR 'All' = '$datname' ) and "namespace" = '$namespace'  GROUP BY "queryid" ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY DESC

spec.description: This table shows number of Active Connections in current moment by role. Also shows Connection Limits that is set during Role create. Also, shows not idle connection by role.
spec.title: Number of Active Connections by Role

spec.expr: sum by (relid, relname, datname, selector) (ma_pg_table_size_by_db{namespace="$namespace", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster", relname=~"$top_tables_by_size"})
spec.query: SELECT top("$column", $limit) as "$column", "short_query", "datname", "mean_time", "queryid" FROM (SELECT LAST("queryid_val"), * FROM "ma.pg.common.queries_stat" WHERE $timeFilter and ("datname" = '$datname' OR 'All' = '$datname' ) and "namespace" = '$namespace'  GROUP BY "queryid" ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY DESC

spec.expr: sum by (relid, relname, datname, selector) (ma_pg_tuples_by_db{namespace="$namespace", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster", relname=~"$top_tables_by_size"})
sum by (relid, relname, datname, selector) (ma_pg_tot_size_by_db{namespace="$namespace", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster", relname=~"$top_tables_by_size"})
sum by (relid, relname, datname, selector) (ma_pg_idx_size_by_db{namespace="$namespace", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster", relname=~"$top_tables_by_size"})

spec.description: The table shows TOP tables filtered by the selected database name.
spec.title: TOP $limit tables by size

spec.description: This Graph Shows size of the each table in all of the databases
spec.title: Size by tables

spec.description: This graphs shows estimated number of rows in all of the tables, using `pg_stat_all_tables` system view.
spec.title: Estimated Number of Rows per Table

spec.query: SELECT top("$column", $limit) as "$column", "short_query", "datname", "mean_time", "queryid" FROM (SELECT LAST("queryid_val"), * FROM "ma.pg.common.queries_stat" WHERE $timeFilter and ("datname" = '$datname' OR 'All' = '$datname' ) and "namespace" = '$namespace'  GROUP BY "queryid" ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY DESC

spec.description:
The table shows TOP queries filtered by the selected column and database name.  For queries statistics `pg_stat_statements`  view used. More info about columns could be find in official docs.

Also, it is possible to reset the statistics, by calling `pg_stat_statements_reset()` function.
spec.title: TOP $limit queries by $column

spec.expr: sum by (datname, db_namespace, microservice, tenant_id) (last_over_time(ma_pg_dbaas{namespace="$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range:]))

spec.description: Postgres server version
spec.title: Version

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+\..*pg_metrics\.replication_connections/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by service_name, time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the number of replication connections to PostgreSQL pods.
spec.title: Replication Connections

spec.description: Shows objects and chunks count for PG Large Objects.
spec.title: Large Objects Count

spec.description: Shows total size of PG Large objects in bytes.
spec.title: Size of large objects

spec.expr: sum by(relname, datname) (ma_pg_default_partition_size_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", datname=~"$datname", relname=~"$relname", cluster=~"$cluster"})
sum by(relname, datname) (ma_pg_default_partition_row_count{relname=~"$relname", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="$namespace"})

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+.*\.pg_metrics\.locks$/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Number of locks from pg_locks view.
spec.title: Locks

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+.*\.pg_metrics\.locks_not_granted/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval)

spec.description: Number of locks from pg_locks view that are not granted.
spec.title: Locks not granted

spec.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("value"), 1s) FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+.*\.pg_metrics\.xact_sum/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Estimated value for transactions per second. Calculated as transaction amount for last 30 seconds divided by 30.
spec.title: TPS

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg.$cluster_name.endpoints.cluster.running/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows whether monitoring is able to connect to PostgreSQL through the endpoint.
spec.title: Endpoint Cluster Status (1 = Running)

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg.$cluster_name.endpoints.cluster.smoketest.delete.*time_ms$/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the execution time for a **single** RW request (select, insert, update, delete) through the endpoint.
spec.title: Smoke Tests Timings

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM /pg.$cluster_name.nodes.*.smoketest.delete.*check$/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description:
This like the "Smoke test" section, with one difference - this section executes smoketests directly on the master pod.
The difference in execution allows distinguishing between cases of master unavailability and endpoint failure.
spec.title: Smoke Test

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM/pg.$cluster_name.nodes.*.smoketest.delete.*time_ms$/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description:
This like the "Smoke test" section, with one difference - this section executes smoketests directly on the master pod.
 The difference in execution allows distinguishing between cases of master unavailability and endpoint failure.
spec.title: Smoke Tests Timings

spec.query: select /value/ from /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+.*\.pg_metrics\.xlog_location/ where namespace = '$namespace' and $timeFilter

spec.description:
Shows current XLOG location. This value is correlated with the transaction count, or the number of changes made to the database.
The master and replica should have the same value, with a short period while the replica catches up to the master. 
The value on the replica can be slightly less than the master's, but should increase over time.
spec.title: XLOG Location

spec.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="", container!="POD", namespace="$namespace", pod="$namespace_pods", cluster=~"$cluster"}[2m])) by (pod_name, container)
spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM "cpu/usage_rate" WHERE "type" = 'pod_container' AND "namespace_name" = '$namespace' AND "container_name" = '$container_name' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), pod_name fill(null)

spec.description: Shows CPU consumption in PostgreSQL pods based on metrics collected from docker. This section does not use collector metrics.
spec.title: CPU Usage: $namespace_pods

spec.query: SELECT max("value") FROM "memory/usage" WHERE "type" = 'pod_container' AND "namespace_name" = '$namespace' AND  "container_name" = '$container_name'  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), pod_name  fill(null)

SELECT max("value") FROM "memory/working_set" WHERE "type" = 'pod_container' AND "namespace_name" = '$namespace' AND  "container_name" = '$container_name' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), pod_name  fill(null)

spec.description: Shows memory consumption in PostgreSQL pods based on metrics collected from docker. This section does not use collector metrics.
spec.title: Memory Usage: $namespace_pods

spec.query: SELECT last(value) FROM /status/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description:
Backup status shows the state of the backup daemon. The backup status can be one of following:
 
* OK - There is at least one successful backup, and the latest backup is successful.
* WARNING - There are no successful backups, or the last backup failed.
spec.title: Last Backup Status

spec.query: SELECT /value/ FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+.*\.metrics\.df\.pcent/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by service_name

spec.description: Shows disk usage for PostgreSQL pods.
spec.title: Disk Usage Percentage

spec.query: SELECT last(value) FROM "ma.storage.last.metrics.size" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the size of the last backup.
spec.title: Backup Last Version Size

spec.query: SELECT last(value) FROM /storage\.size/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(null)
SELECT last(value) FROM /storage\.total_space/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description:
Shows the space occupied by backups and the remaining amount of space. 
Not all storage supports total size, so "Total Volume Space" metrics can be zeroed.
spec.title: Storage Size/Free Space

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM /storage\.lastSuccessful\.metrics\.spent_time/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter  GROUP BY time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows time spent on last backup.
spec.title: Time Spent on Backup

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.storage.last.end_timestamp_ago" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the period of time when the last backup process was ended.
spec.title: Time of Last Backup

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.backup_is_in_progress" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description:
Shows the current activity status of the backup daemon. The activity status can be one of following:
* Not Active - There is no running backup process.
* In Progress - The backup process is running.
spec.title: Backup Activity Status

spec.query: SELECT last(value) FROM "ma.storage.type" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter

spec.description: Shows the backup storage type.
spec.title: Storage Type

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.storage.lastSuccessful.end_timestamp_ago" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the period of time when the last successful backup process was ended.
spec.title: Time of Last Successful Backup

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.storage.dump_count" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the amount of available backups.
spec.title: Backup Versions Count

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.storage.successful_dump_count" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the amount of successful backups.
spec.title: Successful Backup Versions Count

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.backup.time_until_next_backup" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the time when backup and eviction will be started.
spec.title: Next Backup

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.storage.outdated_backup_count" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter  GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the number of backups that will be evicted next time.
spec.title: Outdated Backup Count

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ma.backup_is_in_progress" WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the changes of activity status on the chart.
spec.title: Backup Activity Status

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+.*\.pg_metrics\.db_count/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows current DB count in PostgreSQL pods.
spec.title: DataBases Count

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.node\d+\..*\.current_connections/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by service_name, time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the number of connections to PostgreSQL pods.
spec.title: Current Connections

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM /pg.$cluster_name.nodes.node.*.pg_metrics.running/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)
select 1 - ( max("value") / 14 - max("value") % 14 / 14)  from /ma.status/  WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by service_name, time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows whether metric sources work. If the value is greater than 1, then the source returns error. If the value is zero, then the source is down.
spec.title: Metric Sources (1 = OK)

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM/pg.$cluster_name.nodes.*.archive.delay$/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the time in seconds since the last WAL file was archived. If rotation is disabled, and load on server is close to zero, this value can reach thousand of seconds.
spec.title: Archive Lag, s

spec.query: SELECT mean(value) FROM/pg.$cluster_name.nodes.*.archive.failed_count/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the amount of failed attempts to flush WAL files to archive. If this value is greater than 0, the system checks whether backup daemon is running and has enough space to store files.
spec.title: Failed to archive

spec.query: SELECT last(value) FROM /storage\.archive_size/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and service_name='postgres-backup-daemon' and $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval) fill(null)

spec.description: Shows the space occupied by WAL archive and the remaining amount of space. Not all storage supports total size, so "Total Volume Space" metrics can be zeroed.
spec.title: Storage Size/Free Space

spec.query: SELECT /value/ FROM /pg\.$cluster_name\.nodes\.$short_container_name\.metrics\.du\.(.?)/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter group by service_name

spec.description: Shows usage by well-known consumers, such as pg_xlog or base directories.
spec.title: Disk Usage

spec.query: SELECT value FROM /collector.duration/ WHERE namespace='$namespace' and $timeFilter fill(null)
label_values(ma_status, cluster)
label_values(ma_status{cluster=~"$cluster"},namespace)
label_values(kube_pod_info{exported_namespace=~"^$namespace$", cluster=~"$cluster"}, exported_pod)
label_values(kube_pod_info{exported_namespace=~"^$namespace$", cluster=~"$cluster"}, exported_pod)
label_values(ma_pg_size_by_database{namespace="$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster"},datname)
label_values(ma_pg_connection_by_role{namespace="$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster"},usename)

spec.label: Top By Column
spec.name: column
spec.query: calls, max_time, min_time, mean_time, total_time

spec.definition: query_result(topk($limit, sum by (relid, datname, relname) (last_over_time(ma_pg_table_size_by_db{namespace="$namespace", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range:]))))
spec.name: top_tables_by_size

spec.query: query_result(topk($limit, sum by (relid, datname, relname) (last_over_time(ma_pg_table_size_by_db{namespace="$namespace", datname=~"$datname", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range:]))))
label_values(ma_pg_default_partition_size_bytes{datname=~"$datname"},relname)
